scope: Current local validation catalogue and frontend startup, project preferences, authentication callback and media loading. No publication or paid generation.

fixed.trigger: A validation entry exists but its placement metadata is missing.
fixed.before: Module initialization throws TypeError reading asset.label; reproduced in a regression test.
fixed.after: Inspector options require matching placement ID and variant ID. Unavailable entries are omitted; other options remain usable.

fixed.trigger: Browser storage is inaccessible or writes exceed its quota.
fixed.before: Theme module initialization or the authentication mount effect can interrupt startup.
fixed.after: Theme choices work in memory, invalid saved values use light, and inaccessible credentials leave public pages usable and the app signed out.

fixed.trigger: Saving or reading the optional active-plan-layer preference throws.
fixed.before: An effect or layer-selection event can throw before finishing its UI update.
fixed.after: Optional persistence is guarded; layer state can still update.

fixed.trigger: Credential storage becomes inaccessible during URL resolution or periodic/focus ticket renewal.
fixed.before: An uncaught storage exception or rejected renewal promise; reproduced in the browser and a regression test.
fixed.after: Treat inaccessible credentials as no session, discard private cached tickets, and preserve public/shared URL behavior.

fixed.trigger: OAuth credential storage fails, or storage removal throws during failed-profile cleanup.
fixed.before: An uncaught effect error or rejection; reproduced in component tests.
fixed.after: Attempt credential cleanup, reset in-memory session state, and return to sign-in with an explanation. Credential write failure never reports successful sign-in.

browser: Fresh session with localStorage getter throwing SecurityError: sign-in loads and focus renewal produces no uncaught page error after fix.
Theme control remains usable with storage blocked.
Fresh session with setItem throwing QuotaExceededError: OAuth callback using dummy test credentials returns to sign-in with no uncaught page error.
Existing authenticated QA project: blocked plan-layer preference removal does not trigger the app error screen.

Existing authenticated QA project: street catalogue opens with 79 total choices, including 28 streets; displayed thumbnails visually checked. Two pre-existing empty page-error records remained unchanged.
verification.runtime_manifest: Regenerated; only the new browserPreferences source dependency was added. No asset inventory changed.

reviewed_controls: Native park, native street, LEGO building, generic model and park-kit loading paths have local React error boundaries.
Zone draft, reference-layer and recent compile persistence already guards storage or JSON decoding.
limits: This is a bounded crash investigation, not exhaustive fuzzing of all saved geometry or every backend feature.
Legacy street registry initialization still assumes the checked-in Calgary local/collector definitions exist; both exist in this checkout.
Geometry calculations outside model error boundaries can still depend on valid saved coordinates. Arbitrarily corrupted server data was not certified safe.
No GPU context-loss, low-memory or prolonged network-failure stress test was performed.
Blocked storage still prevents persistent authenticated sign-in; the fix keeps the page usable and explains callback failure.

The broader runtime manifest still reports 3739 unhydrated or absent library files in this checkout. This predates this initiative and is separate from the 123 current-catalogue model files restored in the preceding commit.
No assets were generated or modified for this initiative. Browser evidence is outside the source tree. Pre-existing generated and hydrated files were preserved.
